title: Sparse causal action-effect extrapolation and out-of-basis falsification

parent.prior_negative: WSP62 351/384 vs fixed parent 156/384, exact memory 350/384; 11 correct unobserved vs frozen 25, so SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE; focused Linux/Windows and G29 PASS; inherited regression pending

question: Can a compressed action-effect representation use fewer no-reset physical actions to predict state-action outcomes absent from its experience, while maintaining safety when confronted with deliberately out-of-model rules?
hypothesis: In frozen low-degree sources, factoring each action into one inferred affected sensor bit and its 3-input Boolean trigger will generalize across unobserved state-action contexts and outperform exact memorization at 48 charged actions; a distinct cubic source provides a failure diagnostic for underpowered rules.

source.families: 4 chain, 4 XOR-and-conjunction degree-two, 4 cubic-three-input AND negative-control worlds; different WSP63 SHA256 salt and newly shuffled sensor role/channel maps; not independent natural world transfer
source.physics: Four binary physical registers, four hidden shuffled primitive action channels. Every action toggles exactly one hidden target register whenever a hidden Boolean trigger of the other three registers is true. Degree-two trigger for in-family, degree-three for negative-control. One root action always triggers, supporting physical reachability.
source.training: 48 chronological charged actions/arm from fixed all-zero state, no arbitrary-state query, teleport, reset, oracle action hints or evaluator source imports. Agent and controls are independently live stateful sessions.
source.testing: 32 oracle-reachable shortest 2–6-action start-to-goal sensor states/world, held out until evaluation, 384 goals total; all 64 state/action physical outcomes per world independently audited, explicitly separate previously observed vs unseen states.
source.cohort: SELFTEST only; DEV/PRIMARY first use forbidden
source.action_policies: Frozen WSP61 source-blind action-selection policy produces exact same 48 charged history for compressed WSP63, frozen WSP62 model, and exact lookup control. Separate random-action 48 transition history is diagnostic only.
source.whole_process: Log action count, distinct source states and state/action pairs, model rank, confident errors, missing coverage, user-visible task plans, memory bytes, CPU/wall and source receipts.

method.representation: Infer a unique affected output bit per action from nontrivial observed deltas (if none or contradictory changed bits, abstain). Other three register values are the input context of one Boolean action-trigger function. Fit degree<=2 GF(2) ANF of 3 bits by observed physical toggles; 7 coefficient dimensions per action versus 11 per output bit in WSP62. Preserve any model inconsistency as abstention.
method.prediction_safety: When the 7-dimensional degree<=2 version space uniquely determines a trigger, apply it to the affected bit and leave other bits unchanged. This is explicitly an aligned single-effect prior; not guaranteed safe on cubic out-of-basis physics.
method.cold_storage: Persist full chronological public observations and derived affected-bit / coefficient rank with exact canonical SHA256 snapshot, cold restoration parity and tamper rejection. No source role import or heldout feedback.
controls: Exact action/state history lookup on same 48 actions
Unchanged frozen WSP62 quadratic ANF learner on same 48 actions
Unchanged frozen WSP61 <=3-parent learner on same 48 actions
Seeded random 48-action compressed model; separate physically reachable state path

primary: SELFTEST_SIGNAL only if across the 8 preregistered degree<=2 worlds, (a) compressed agent solves >=180/256 heldout goals, (b) solves >=20 more goals than same-ledger exact memory lookup, (c) predicts >=35 correct previously unobserved physical action/state outcomes and has zero confidently wrong transitions in all 8x64 audits, (d) every arm has exactly 48 charged continuous transitions and 8 cold restores pass. In the 4 cubic out-of-family worlds, additionally require zero confidently wrong transitions across all 4x64 audit queries; otherwise preserve negative/inconclusive classification. No post-result family/threshold modification.
secondary: All 12-world 384-task results and 12x64 physical transition audit
Source-family breakdown including cubic out-of-basis errors and contradiction abstentions
Compute comparison including action-policy overhead and whole test end-to-end cost; not only action count
Gradient=0, numerical table coefficients, snapshot bits, cold retention and tamper controls
Exact result on unseen state-action pairs; no task leakage or source import
caveats: The single-changed-bit mechanism and low-degree trigger hypothesis are explicitly source-aligned; success is not discovery of unbounded representation primitives.
The out-of-family cubic triggers may agree with degree-two rules on limited evidence, so confident errors are possible and must not be hidden.
The same original WSP61 action policy may undersample informative contexts; no post-hoc tuning based on results.
Strong independent neural and symbolic fully trained matched compute controls absent; no scientific superiority or general intelligence claim.
Goals are raw binary sensor vectors and tests use evaluator-selected reachable starts, not natural language or open-world autonomous goals.
stop_rules: Freeze source seeds, 48-action budget, success threshold and comparator set before new source/learner/tests/outcomes.
If mechanical harness fails, document/repair without changing scientific protocol, then requalify exact source.
Never alter WSP62 frozen outcomes or reclassify WSP61/WSP62 negatives.
Full focused Linux+Windows, G29 atlas and inherited full regression required before engineering acceptance.
